title: Z1 OOD error reduction re-run on 160 OOD labels
why: PR #121 used the old 60 OOD labels (n_bad=9); re-run on the merged 160 labels with honest factory-grouped CIs.
hypothesis: The sharpness-3 zero-shot head (0.706 at n=60) survives at n_bad=22; few-shot curve is lower.
data: IndEgo manifest_gold n=150 + labels/ood160_labels.json n=160 (138 good/22 bad, 47 factories)
method: logistic on IndEgo (LOCO) applied zero-shot; unsupervised alignment; per-clip norm; factory-grouped few-shot

summary: Sharpness-3 zero-shot head confirmed: OOD-160 AUROC 0.708 [0.588,0.823] vs frozen 0.566; few-shot curve lower than at n=60 (k=48 -> 0.664); alignment/per-clip/self-training still do not help.
